name: Muse Code
description: Handles long-horizon, multi-file coding work across large repositories from the terminal, spawning persistent async sub-agents that keep working in the background.

skills.name: Long-Horizon Editing
skills.description: Sustains multi-file changes across large repositories over long sessions without losing track of earlier edits.

skills.name: Background Sub-Agents
skills.description: Spawns persistent asynchronous sub-agents that continue working on delegated subtasks while the main session proceeds.

skills.name: Repository Comprehension
skills.description: Reads and navigates large codebases to locate relevant modules before proposing cross-cutting changes.
